page.overview:
What is Razor Grass?

Razor Grass was a type of grass-like plant native to Genna with white blade-like leaves.

As its name implied, Razor Grass' leaves were quite sharp, able to cut through even the hide of a Yauja — the reason not only Bone Bisons evolved their distinct armor so they wouldn't cut themselves while feeding on such plants, but also being a suitable material for crafting an effective whip as Dek discovered. He Later used the material to forge a pair of replacement wristblades.
